hooks.command: branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commits directs sur main sont bloques — cree une branche dabord (feat/xxx, fix/xxx, chore/xxx)."}}'; fi
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; pnpm exec prettier --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
